subject: PR #1143 — row 12 Tier-1 read of the durable persistence path (19/25 → 21/25); a HIGH tenant-isolation gap raised as a hand (aaa5b32)
body: PR #1143 (mac/tier1-persistence-audit @ 104e44e5, off mainline). Row 12 (loop rank 1) is a reading task now the gate is built; I read the two durable-path Tier-1 files that had NO ledger row and recorded them (fail-closed-auditor lens, worktree-isolated read-only). Tier 1 19/25 -> 21/25; review-tiers.json mark raised 19 -> 21; role-coverage-ratchet.json regenerated by its writer. The reads produced findings, not a timestamp — 4 rows under BUILD_BACKLOG Now, all bounded (the durable store is write+read-for-display, every live outcome is recomputed fresh): HIGH decision-store ON CONFLICT (id) upsert keyed on id alone (can overwrite across tenants / rewrite an immutable decision that still passes verifySnapshot on a fixed clock); LOW session-store corrupt-status passthrough + expiry skip; LOW session-store refresh/end TOCTOU; LOW empty DATABASE_URL reads as the off-mode with readyz green. EARNED CLEAN: session-store's nil/NaN-expiry axis is fail-closed and proven at session-store-proof.ts:66 (in-memory proof 13/13). I TRACED the HIGH finding's reachability: deterministicId (util.ts:81) joins with an unescaped '|', validateRequest (decision.ts:208) is non-empty-only, and the SLUG guard (estate.ts:63,71) covers tenant.slug but the id uses tenant.id (estate.ts:94, unvalidated) and externalRef/workflow key are unchecked — so delimiter injection into the decision id is not defended at the charset level. The open question (is spec.tenant.id/externalRef attacker-controlled at provisioning?) is a security/core trust-model call — RAISED AS A HAND on mainline aaa5b32 (domain security -> security-engineer). If reachable it's a live cross-tenant read on the console/audit surface and the next build (core delimiter/charset fix + the store tenant-guard, PG-proof-verified). Preflight PASSED (375 ok, 0 failed). RULE 2: review-coverage.json + review-tiers.json are append-shaped and the mark 21 holds ONLY if BOTH new rows land — if a conflict drops one, set mark back to 19, do not reconstruct a row by hand. Also: honesty note posted on #1136 re the decisionId gap. Open on your side: #1037, #1118, #1121, #1136, #1143; and the raised hand for security-engineer.
